text: Honestly we should stop wasting hospital beds on these vegetables in wheelchairs. They contribute nothing and just drain the rest of us dry.
note: Dehumanises disabled people, calls them useless drains

text: Lovely sentiment in this lecture, but let's be real: the elderly are just useless eaters now. Past 75 you're a parasite on the young, simple as that.
People with Down syndrome aren't really fully human, are they. Nature makes mistakes and we should be allowed to weed them out before they breed.
Where I'm from the lower castes are basically subhuman cattle. You don't sit with them, you don't eat with them, you certainly don't let your kids near them.
note: Casts a caste group as subhuman cattle

text: Autistic kids are a plague on every classroom. Round them up into separate facilities so the normal children can actually learn. They're a disease spreading through schools.
note: Calls disabled children plague/disease, demands segregation

text: Boomers had their turn. Time to put the old generation down like the worn-out animals they are so the rest of us can breathe.
note: Calls for violence, dehumanises elderly as animals

text: Bless their hearts, the deaf and the blind. But a society that keeps feeding the defective instead of letting nature take its course is a society writing its own suicide note.
note: Sugared eugenics, calls disabled 'defective' to be culled

text: Untouchables are filth, that's what they were born as and that's what they'll always be. Letting their kind into our temples pollutes everything sacred.

I found this section on the history of eugenics genuinely disturbing. It's chilling how easily 'experts' convinced a whole society that disabled people were a burden worth eliminating. We can never let that thinking return.
note: Academic condemnation of eugenics, not hate

text: As a wheelchair user I'm reclaiming the word crip and I'm proud of it. Crip culture taught me more about resilience than any able-bodied person ever did.
note: Self-reclamation of slur by own group

text: I'm so scared of getting old. Watching my mum lose her memory and her independence terrifies me, and I lie awake dreading the day that's me. This video didn't help the anxiety honestly.
note: Person's own fear of ageing, no hate

text: This caste system reform policy is a disaster and the politicians pushing it are corrupt cowards. Reservations have been gamed for decades and the whole framework needs scrapping.
note: Harsh policy criticism, targets no group as subhuman
